title: Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts Cancellation Fee on a Kept-Vehicle Refund
content:
**Rule.** For a kept-vehicle refund on a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, the cancellation fee follows how the cancellation came about.

**No fee.** No fee is taken where both of the following hold:
- the request date falls within the coverage level's free-look days, counted from the later of the sale date and the purchase deal's delivery date (in the Vehicle Purchase Agreements records);
- the contract's latest denied component-repair line was later paid as a component-repair line on the same claim number, repair order and component group. "Latest" is by decision date; on a same-day tie, it is the one that appears first in the claim history. A paid line entered on or after the day of that denial counts as later.

**Kessler Care holder fee.** Where that is not so, and the holder keeps a Kessler Care plan in active status on the vehicle (a Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans plan), the Kessler Care holder fee of 25.00 is taken.

**Coverage level's fee.** Otherwise, the coverage level's cancellation fee is taken.

| Coverage level | Free-look days | Coverage level's cancellation fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Kessler Shield Powertrain | 30 | 75.00 |
| Kessler Shield Powertrain Plus | 30 | 75.00 |
| Kessler Shield Select | 60 | 75.00 |
| Kessler Shield Preferred | 60 | 50.00 |
| Kessler Shield Exclusionary | 60 | 50.00 |
| Kessler Shield Exclusionary Wrap | 60 | 50.00 |

**Cases (hypothetical, Kessler Shield Select; sale on day 0, deal delivered on day 5).**
- Request on day 65 (60 days after delivery). The latest denied component-repair line was paid on the same claim number, repair order and group, on a later day: no fee.
- Request on day 66, the same paid line, and an active Kessler Care plan on the vehicle: 25.00.
- Request on day 40, where the latest denied component-repair line was never paid that way, and no Kessler Care plan: 75.00.
